description: Estacionamiento regulado en Sant Cugat del Vallès is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by santcugat.cat. Regulated parking in Sant Cugat del Vallès is a set of geographical information regarding the location of the streets and the type of regulated car parks in the municipality of Sant Cugat. The spatial representation of this data is carried out by means of two planes in PDF format. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Regulated parking in Sant Cugat del Vallès" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Catalunya, Motor vehicle, Vehicles de motor, Parking provision, Europa, Sant Cugat del Vallès. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
